definitions.explanation: the state of psychological and emotional well-being, or the field concerned with maintaining it

notes:
USAGE:
Common in workplace and public-health contexts. Since 2015, workplaces with 50 or more employees must give staff a yearly ストレスチェック (stress check), and many companies offer {産業医|さんぎょうい} (company doctor) consultations and a ⟦{相談窓口|そうだんまどぐち}→相談窓口：23532_soudanmadoguchi⟧ (counseling contact).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- メンタルヘルス⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧ - mental health measures
- メンタルヘルスケア - mental health care
- メンタルヘルス⟦{不調|ふちょう}→不調：11303_fuchou⟧ - mental health problems

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{心|こころ}→心：01321_kokoro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{健康|けんこう}→健康：02706_kenkou⟧ - the native phrase, softer and used in public campaigns
- {精神的健康|せいしんてきけんこう} - more technical

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{燃|も}え{尽|つ}き{症候群|しょうこうぐん}→燃え尽き症候群：08597_moetsukishoukougun⟧ - burnout
- ⟦{適応障害|てきおうしょうがい}→適応障害：08598_tekioushougai⟧ - adjustment disorder
- うつ{病|びょう} - depression
